title: p
description:
What about the remaining 99% of text that isn't supposed to be a heading? Those are typically called paragraphs, and guess what, the HTML tag for a paragraph is just . . . `p`. P tags are very simple. You just put `

{text here}

`. Note, both `p` and `h` elements are _block elements_. Block elements create a newline after their closing tag. --- ## Assignment: We want a 500 error page! Make the first line a `h1`, with content `500: Internal Server Error`, then a `p` with content `The server was unable to complete your request. Please try again later.`
